Shri Vishal V.R. Daniel - Advocate for petitioner.
 Shri Piyush Jain - Public Prosecutor for State.
 Order
This is the first bail application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C filed by the applicant.
Applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.112/2024 for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 409, 420 and 120- B of IPC at Police Station-Jaisinagar, Sagar (M.P.).
I t is alleged that the applicant has not committed any offence in any manner and he has been falsely implicated in the case.
It is submitted that the entire enquiry has been conducted behind the back of the applicant and no opportunity of hearing was granted to him.

He has drawn attention of this court to representation dated 03.04.2024 addressed to the Chief Executive Officer, Jila Panchayat,
Sagar and thereafter the document dated 16.04.2024 wherein the Chief Executive Officer, Jila Panchayat, Sagar intimating the applicant and another with respect to documents asked by him.

He again intimated that in case he appears before the office of Chief Executive Officer, Jila Panchayat,
Sagar on any working date, then the document will be supplied to him.

Thereafter, the documents were supplied to the applicant, wherein he has denied his signature 2 MCRC-27738-2024 on the document, which is stated to be service of notice upon the present applicant by the State counsel.
It is further pointed out that entire embezzled amount i.e. Rs.9,00,752/- as far as the present applicant is concerned, has already been deposited under protest.
He is contesting the matter.
He is ready to cooperate with the Investigating Agency and prays for grant of anticipatory bail.

P e r contra, counsel for the State has vehemently opposed the bail application stating that during an enquiry a notice was issued on 09.02.2024, which was served upon the present applicant on 14.02.2024 wherein he has refused to take notice.
There is an endorsement with respect to the same upon the aforesaid notice.

But, subsequently there is a letter dated 16.04.2024 issued by the Chief Jitendra Singh Thakur vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68551221/

sentences.text: Executive Officer, Jila Panchayat, Sagar asking the applicant to come to the office and collect those documents.
The explanation tendered by the State counsel to the aforesaid document is that both the offices are different.

The notice was issued to the petitioner from the office of the Janpad Panchayat, Jaisinagar, Sagar and this letter dated 16.04.2024 has been issued from the Jila Panchayat, Sagar, therefore, the both the offices are different.

It is further pointed out that this notice which has been issued in pursuance to the departmental proceedings to be taken upon against the applicant in pursuance to Section 89 of the Madhya Pradesh Panchayat Raj Adhiniyam,
1993.
However, the record indicates contrary.
The document i.e. letter dated 16.04.2024 is written by the Chief Executive Officer, Jila Panchayat, Sagar.
Thereafter, after a lapse of eight days, a notice under Section 89 of the Madhya Pradesh Panchayat Raj Adhiniyam, 1993 has been issued on 24.04.2024.
Therefore, the argument is contrary to the document placed on record.
He is not disputing the fact that the entire embezzled amount has been deposited by the applicant under 3 MCRC-27738-2024 protest.
However, he submits that another case is pending against the petitioner for the offences punishable under Sections 307 and 149 of the Indian Penal Code vide Crime No.202 of 2004.
He has prayed for dismissal of the application.
Considering the over all facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court deems it appropriate to allow this application for grant of anticipatory bail.

In the event of arrest, the applicant is directed to be released on bail on furnishing a surety bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with separate local solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Arresting Officer.
T he applicant is directed to mark his presence before the concerning Police Station in first week of every month and is directed to cooperate in investigation.
In case of failure to cooperate, the bail granted by this Court shall stand rejected automatically.

The applicant/s shall not involve any other offence, in case the 4 MCRC-27738-2024 applicant/s indulge in any other criminal case the benefit of bail as extended by this Court shall automatically cancelled.
